stories.title: Müstehcen içerik paylaştıkları gerekçesiyle 419 sosyal medya hesabına erişim engeli

en.title: Access blocked to 419 social media accounts for sharing obscene content
en.summary: An investigation by Istanbul's chief prosecutor's office resulted in blocking access to 419 social media accounts identified as distributing obscene content.

stories.title: YENİ Partili belediye başkanı protesto etti: Protokole sırtını döndü!

en.title: YENİ Party mayor protests: Turned back on protocol
en.summary: The mayor of Didim protested after her name was read after the district education director during a school opening ceremony, turning her back on the protocol.

stories.title: Üsküdar’da seçim öncesi AKP'ye geçmişti… Tahsin Usta belediye başkan yardımcısı oldu

en.title: Switched to AKP before Üsküdar election… Tahsin Usta became deputy mayor
en.summary: A former CHP member who switched to AKP and helped facilitate a change in Üsküdar Municipality's administration has been appointed as deputy mayor.

stories.title: Ailem Güvende soruşturması! 419 sosyal medya hesabı ve linke erişim engeli

en.title: Family Safe investigation! 419 social media accounts and links blocked
en.summary: Istanbul's chief prosecutor's office took significant action against obscene content online during the Family Safe investigation by blocking access to numerous accounts and links.

stories.title: Avcılar’da THY personel servis minibüsü ile otomobil çarpıştı: 11 yaralı

en.title: Turkish Airlines personnel service minibus collides with car in Avcılar: 11 injured
en.summary: A minibus carrying Turkish Airlines staff collided with a car in Avcılar, resulting in 11 people being injured. The minibus struck a building wall after the collision, and the D-100 highway toward Edirne was closed to traffic.

stories.title: AKP'ye geçti makamı kaptı! Tahsin Usta Üsküdar Belediyesi'nde Başkan Yardımcısı oldu

en.title: Switched to AKP and got the position! Tahsin Usta became Deputy Mayor at Üsküdar Municipality
en.summary: A municipal council member controversially left the CHP and joined the AKP before Üsküdar Municipality elections, subsequently obtaining a position as Deputy Mayor.

stories.title: Törene damga vuran an! Belediye başkanı protokole sırtını döndü

en.title: The moment that marked the ceremony! Municipality mayor turned his back to the protocol
en.summary: During an education ceremony held in Didim, Aydın for the start of the 2026-2027 academic year, a municipality mayor turned away from the official protocol arrangement.

en.title: Illegal betting operation in Aydın: 9 arrests
en.summary: Simultaneous operations targeting illegal gambling activities in Kuşadası, Didim, and Söke districts of Aydın resulted in nine suspects being arrested. Bank account investigations revealed approximately 623 million 588 thousand lira in transaction volume.

stories.title: Avcılar’da servis midibüsü duvara çarptı: 9 yaralı

en.title: Service minibus crashes into wall in Avcılar: 9 injured
en.summary: A service minibus lost control on D-100 Highway in Avcılar and struck a wall at a business entrance, resulting in nine people being injured.

stories.title: Aydın’da yasa dışı bahis operasyonunda 9 tutuklama

en.title: 9 arrests in illegal betting operation in Aydın
en.summary: An operation against illegal betting activities in Kuşadası, Didim, and Söke districts of Aydın led to nine suspects being detained.

stories.title: ÖSYM'den KPSS için flaş karar: 392 aday yeniden sınava alınacak!

en.title: ÖSYM flash decision for KPSS: 392 candidates will retake exam
en.summary: ÖSYM announced that 392 candidates will retake the 2026 KPSS Lisans exam after procedural violations were found in 22 exam halls at Şanlıurfa Harran University.

stories.title: SON DAKİKA! ÖSYM'den Şanlıurfa'daki KPSS Oturumu'na ilişkin açıklama: Eş değer sınav yapılmasına karar verilmiştir

en.title: BREAKING: ÖSYM statement on Şanlıurfa KPSS session: decision made for equivalent exam
en.summary: ÖSYM announced that designated candidates will take an equivalent exam for the 2026 KPSS Lisans session in Şanlıurfa to ensure fairness and equal opportunity.

stories.title: MİT Başkanı Kalın, Afganistan’da temaslarda bulundu

en.title: MIT Chief Kalın Conducts Contacts in Afghanistan
en.summary: Turkey's National Intelligence Organization head Ibrahim Kalın visited Kabul and Kandahar, meeting with Afghanistan's intelligence director and interim government officials.

en.title: Access Blocked to 419 Social Media Accounts
en.summary: Turkish prosecutors blocked access to 419 social media accounts found to contain obscene content and links flagged for similar material.

en.title: Borsa Istanbul Closes Day with Losses
en.summary: Istanbul's BIST 100 index declined 5.54 percent, closing at 13,122.58 points.

stories.title: Milli uçak HÜRKUŞ-II Hava Kuvvetleri envanterine giriyor

en.title: National Aircraft HÜRKUŞ-II Entering Air Force Inventory
en.summary: Turkey's domestically developed next-generation basic training aircraft HÜRKUŞ-II is preparing to enter active service with the air force.

stories.title: Fransa'da restoran sektöründe alarm: Binlercesi kepenk indirdi

en.title: Alarm in France's restaurant sector: Thousands have closed
en.summary: More than 4,900 restaurants in France have declared bankruptcy since the beginning of the year as rising costs and energy prices strain the sector.
